title: Restriction of abelian Zariski sheaves to an open is exact and preserves injectives
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $U\subseteq X$ an open subscheme, and $X_{\rm Zar}$, $U_{\rm Zar}$ the small Zariski sites of $X$ and of $U$ [def-sc-zariski-site] (the objects of $U_{\rm Zar}$ are the opens $W\subseteq U$, which are also objects of $X_{\rm Zar}$, and a family of opens of $U$ is a covering in $U_{\rm Zar}$ if and only if it is one in $X_{\rm Zar}$). Let $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ and $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ be the abelian categories of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For $\mathcal F\in\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ let $\mathcal F|_U\in\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ be the abelian sheaf $W\mapsto\mathcal F(W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open) with the restriction maps of $\mathcal F$, and for a morphism $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ let $\varphi|_U:\mathcal F|_U\to\mathcal G|_U$ have components $(\varphi|_U)_W=\varphi_W$. Then: (1) the functor $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})\to\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$, $\mathcal F\mapsto\mathcal F|_U$, is additive and exact (it carries a sequence exact at the middle term [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] to one exact at the middle term); (2) if $\mathcal I$ is an injective object of $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], then $\mathcal I|_U$ is an injective object of $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$; (3) consequently, if $\mathcal F\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ is an injective resolution of $\mathcal F$ in $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], then $\mathcal F|_U\to\mathcal I^\bullet|_U$ (the complex with terms $\mathcal I^p|_U$ and differentials $d^p|_U$) is an injective resolution of $\mathcal F|_U$ in $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$, and $\Gamma(U,\mathcal I^\bullet|_U)=\mathcal I^\bullet(U)$ as complexes of abelian groups.

source.place: Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 03F3 (label lemma-cohomology-of-open), line 607, parts (1) and (2) and its proof, applied to the ringed site (X_Zar, Z) (abelian sheaves = sheaves of Z-modules) and the object U, whose localized site X_Zar/U is U_Zar; the topological-space form is Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 01E1 (label lemma-cohomology-of-open), literature/stacks-project/cohomology.tex line 495, with O_X the constant sheaf Z. The proof there: restriction j_U^{-1} is right adjoint to the exact extension by zero j_{U!}, so it preserves injectives (Homology, Lemma 015Z adjoint-preserve-injectives).

proof.text: *Step 1 (restriction is an additive functor $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})\to\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$).* Let $\mathcal G\in\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$. $W\mapsto\mathcal G(W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open) with the restriction maps of $\mathcal G$ is a presheaf of abelian groups on $U_{\rm Zar}$, since the morphisms of $U_{\rm Zar}$ are inclusions of opens of $U$, which are morphisms of $X_{\rm Zar}$. It is a sheaf: a covering $\{W_i\to W\}$ of $W\subseteq U$ in $U_{\rm Zar}$ is a family of opens of $W$ with union $W$ [def-sc-zariski-site], i.e. a covering of $W$ in $X_{\rm Zar}$, the fibre products $W_i\times_WW_k=W_i\cap W_k$ are the same in both sites, and the equalizer condition of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (1) for $\mathcal G|_U$ on this covering is word for word that for $\mathcal G$. For $\psi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$ the components $\psi_W$, $W\subseteq U$, commute with the restriction maps, so $\psi|_U$ is a morphism; $(\psi'\psi)|_U=\psi'|_U\psi|_U$ and $\mathrm{id}|_U=\mathrm{id}$ componentwise. Morphisms of abelian sheaves are added sectionwise ($\textit{Ab}$ is a full subcategory of the presheaves of abelian groups [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (1), where $(\varphi+\psi)_W=\varphi_W+\psi_W$ [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-presheaves-evaluation-exact]), so $(\varphi+\psi)|_U=\varphi|_U+\psi|_U$ and $0|_U=0$: restriction is additive.

source.place: Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 03F3 (lemma-cohomology-of-open, line 608), the restriction F|_U; Modules on Sites, Definition 04IX (sites-modules.tex line 2019) (4): j_U^*F(X/U) = F(X)

proof.text: *Step 2 (proof of (1): restriction is exact).* Let $\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\varphi}\mathcal G\xrightarrow{\psi}\mathcal H$ be a complex of $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ exact at $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. Its restriction is a complex, $\psi|_U\varphi|_U=(\psi\varphi)|_U=0$ (Step 1). By [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact] (1) on the site $X_{\rm Zar}$, a kernel of $\psi$ is $k:\mathcal K\to\mathcal G$ with $\mathcal K(V)=\operatorname{Ker}(\psi_V)$ and $k$ the inclusion; let $\varphi':\mathcal F\to\mathcal K$ be the factorization, $\varphi'_V(f)=\varphi_V(f)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-exact-iff-epi-kernel-lift] (in the abelian category $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (1)) $\varphi'$ is an epimorphism, so by [lem-weil-pbc-site-abelian-sheaf-epi-locally-surjective] it is locally surjective: for every open $V\subseteq X$ and $s\in\mathcal K(V)$ there are a covering $\{V_i\to V\}$ in $X_{\rm Zar}$ and $f_i\in\mathcal F(V_i)$ with $\varphi_{V_i}(f_i)=s|_{V_i}$. On $U$: by [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact] (1) on the site $U_{\rm Zar}$, a kernel of $\psi|_U$ is the sectionwise kernel $W\mapsto\operatorname{Ker}(\psi_W)$, which is $\mathcal K|_U$ with $k|_U$ as inclusion, and the factorization of $\varphi|_U$ through it is $\varphi'|_U$. It is locally surjective: for $W\subseteq U$ and $s\in\mathcal K|_U(W)=\mathcal K(W)$ take the covering $\{V_i\to W\}$ and the $f_i$ above; the $V_i$ are opens of $W\subseteq U$, so this is a covering of $W$ in $U_{\rm Zar}$ (Step 1) and $(\varphi|_U)_{V_i}(f_i)=s|_{V_i}$. By [lem-weil-pbc-site-abelian-sheaf-epi-locally-surjective] on the site $U_{\rm Zar}$, $\varphi'|_U$ is an epimorphism of $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$, and by [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-exact-iff-epi-kernel-lift] the complex $\mathcal F|_U\to\mathcal G|_U\to\mathcal H|_U$ is exact at $\mathcal G|_U$. With Step 1 this proves (1).

source.place: Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 03F3 (line 608), proof, second paragraph, which uses without proof that F|_U -> I^bullet|_U is again exact; written out by the agent from Modules on Sites Lemma 03CN (sites-modules.tex, lemma-abelian-abelian: kernels sectionwise, epimorphisms = locally surjective maps)

proof.text: *Step 3 (proof of (2): restriction preserves injectives).* Let $j_!:\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})\to\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ be extension by zero. By [lem-weil-pbc-zariski-extension-by-zero-adjunction] (1),(2) it is an additive functor and left adjoint to the restriction functor $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G|_U$ of Step 1, through the natural bijections $\Hom(j_!\mathcal F,\mathcal G)\cong\Hom(\mathcal F,\mathcal G|_U)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-zariski-extension-by-zero-exact] it is an exact functor between the abelian categories $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ and $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (1). Hence [lem-sp-right-adjoint-preserves-injectives], with $u=j_!$ and $u_*=(-)|_U$, gives: if $\mathcal I$ is an injective object of $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], then $\mathcal I|_U$ is an injective object of $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$.

source.place: Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 03F3 (line 608), proof, first paragraph: j_U^{-1} is right adjoint to the exact j_{U!} (Modules on Sites, Section 03DH, Lemmas 03DI and 03DJ), hence (1) by Homology, Lemma 015Z (homology.tex, lemma-adjoint-preserve-injectives, line 7270)

proof.text: *Step 4 (proof of (3): restricted injective resolutions).* Let $\mathcal F\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ be an injective resolution in $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]: each $\mathcal I^p$ is injective, $\mathcal I^p=0$ for $p<0$ (bounded below, indexed so that the cohomology is $\mathcal F$ in degree $0$), and the augmented complex $0\to\mathcal F\to\mathcal I^0\to\mathcal I^1\to\cdots$ is exact at every term [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. Restriction is an additive functor (Step 1), so it carries this complex to the complex $0\to\mathcal F|_U\to\mathcal I^0|_U\to\mathcal I^1|_U\to\cdots$ ($0|_U=0$, $d^{p+1}|_Ud^p|_U=0$), which is exact at every term by Step 2 applied to each three consecutive terms; each $\mathcal I^p|_U$ is injective by Step 3, and $\mathcal I^p|_U=0$ for $p<0$. $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ is abelian with enough injectives [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (1), [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaves-enough-injectives]. Hence $\mathcal F|_U\to\mathcal I^\bullet|_U$ is an injective resolution of $\mathcal F|_U$ in $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$. Finally $\Gamma(U,-)$ on $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ is evaluation at the object $U$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (2), and $(\mathcal I^p|_U)(U)=\mathcal I^p(U)$, $(d^p|_U)_U=d^p_U$ by the definition of restriction, so $\Gamma(U,\mathcal I^\bullet|_U)=\mathcal I^\bullet(U)$ as complexes of abelian groups.

split_report.summary: Checked against Cohomology on Sites 03F3 (statement (1) and proof), Cohomology 01E1, Modules on Sites 03DI/03DJ/04IX, Sheaves 00A4/00A5 and Homology 015Z. The module nodes (lem-weil-pbc-module-open-restriction-injectives, -module-extension-by-zero-adjunction) are stated for a scheme with its structure sheaf O_X, not an arbitrary sheaf of rings, and the DAG has no node identifying abelian sheaves on X_Zar with Z_X-modules, so the abelian case is proved directly following 03F3. Four steps: restriction is an additive functor (elementary, same coverings); exactness of restriction (not proved in 03F3) via sectionwise kernels (lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact (1)), the epi/kernel-lift criterion and epi = locally surjective on both sites; preservation of injectives by lem-sp-right-adjoint-preserves-injectives (015Z, tool from unit sk-thm-groth-ss) applied to j_!, using two new unsplit nodes for the abelian Zariski extension by zero (adjunction, 03DI/00A5; exactness, 03DJ); restricted injective resolutions and Gamma(U, I|_U) = I(U), which is clause (3) used by lem-weil-pbc-zariski-cohomology-locally-zero step 3. Statement kept. Mathlib: no match (composition of injective_of_adjoint, sheafAdjunctionContinuous and a missing mono-preservation of j_!).
